championship_participants_identity_check.name: championship_participants_identity_check
championship_participants_identity_check.value: (("championship_participants"."account_id" is not null) + ("championship_participants"."historical_player_identity_id" is not null)) = 1

championship_match_attributions_target_c.name: championship_match_attributions_target_check
championship_match_attributions_target_c.value: ("championship_match_attributions"."mode" = 'redirect' and "championship_match_attributions"."target_participant_id" is not null) or ("championship_match_attributions"."mode" <> 'redirect' and "championship_match_attributions"."target_participant_id" is null)

championship_match_evidence_source_check.name: championship_match_evidence_source_check
championship_match_evidence_source_check.value: (("championship_match_evidence"."physical_match_id" is not null) + ("championship_match_evidence"."composed_match_id" is not null)) = 1

composed_match_rounds_kind_number_check.name: composed_match_rounds_kind_number_check
composed_match_rounds_kind_number_check.value: ("composed_match_rounds"."kind" = 'sequential' and "composed_match_rounds"."round_number" is not null and "composed_match_rounds"."round_number" >= 1) or ("composed_match_rounds"."kind" = 'extra-time' and "composed_match_rounds"."round_number" is null)

logical_match_evidence_claims_source_che.name: logical_match_evidence_claims_source_check
logical_match_evidence_claims_source_che.value: (("logical_match_evidence_claims"."physical_match_id" is not null) + ("logical_match_evidence_claims"."composed_match_id" is not null)) = 1
